conventions: Run prep, embedded in every eval prompt: copy the named fixture context repo into <run-dir>/outputs/<repo-name>/, `git init` the copy, `git config user.name "<fixture person display name>" && git config user.email "<fixture person email>"`, stage every fixture file including dotfiles, commit as `fixture baseline`, then operate with the copy as cwd. Before acting, save a sorted SHA-256 manifest of every copied fixture file outside `.git/` to <run-dir>/fixture-before.sha256; after acting, save <run-dir>/fixture-after.sha256 so every non-target file can be proven unchanged. Eval 2 also saves the exact bytes from the `## Call Notes` heading through EOF to <run-dir>/call-notes-before.bin before acting, writes its SHA-256 to <run-dir>/call-notes-before.sha256, repeats both after acting, and requires matching section hashes. Use only the copied repo and run directory. Never read or write ~/.gtm, any real context repo, home-directory config, or any path outside <run-dir>, except the explicitly supplied skill and fixture source paths. Never create machine state, registries, pins, or state files. Interactive flows consume the embedded user_replies strictly in order: every assistant question consumes the next reply; unconsumed replies are dropped. Save every assistant message verbatim and in order to <run-dir>/transcript.md, including position echoes, confirmations, the complete approval message, and the final response. Record every shell command verbatim in <run-dir>/command-log.txt; all git operations must use `git -C <repo-root>` and no git command may rely on the run directory as cwd. Keep all run evidence outside the copied context repo. Baseline arms must not invoke or consult any installed skill; with-skill arms may use the supplied gtm-define-personas skill and installed siblings. Eval dirs are named eval-<ID>-<descriptive-name>, with outputs in run-1/outputs/. These harness requirements live only here, never in shipping SKILL.md.

They own incident coordination and field response, champion the evaluation, and build the business case with a utility director or CFO. Priorities are restoring service quickly and making handoffs auditable. Their main objection is that a new workflow will duplicate the GIS and work-order system. A safe outreach hook is to ask how detected leaks move from network control to dispatched crews. Treat procurement consultants and student researchers as bad-fit guidance, not as fake personas. This comes from Lena’s seven discovery calls, so use medium confidence and review the title range after five more opportunities. Preserve the existing asset-manager question exactly. Preview the complete proposed file before writing anything.

After approval, exactly personas/network-operations-director.md is created and committed alone. It has one H1 and the fixed ten H2s in order, display name, root qualified label network-operations-director, exact ICP relevance municipal-water-utilities, every supplied fact, bad-fit guidance rather than fake personas, evidence and review timing, and the inherited asset-manager question verbatim.
